facts.text: I asked whether there are new developments or advancements in chemotherapy that aim to address challenges associated with the treatment.
I asked whether the new chemotherapy advancements are widely available yet.
I asked whether the chemotherapy advancements are accessible to patients without breaking the bank.
I asked whether the chemotherapy advancements are expensive.
I said personalized therapy is becoming more of a treatment option and that it gives me hope treatment can be tailored to my needs if I ever have to go through chemotherapy.
I asked about options that can help minimize the side effects of chemotherapy.
I said I have heard chemotherapy can be a tough treatment to go through and that anything that can make it easier would be great.
I said healthcare providers are prioritizing patient-centric care and personalized treatments and that it gives me hope for the future of cancer treatment.
